name: Dispel Evil and Good
description: For 1 minute, concentration, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. This is only that always-on disadvantage. It is not immunity to charmed or frightened (that is Protection from Evil and Good). Break Enchantment, Dismissal, and possession are deferred. The material is not consumed.

m.text: holy water or powdered silver and iron
